lines.text: A jealous husband with no proof must bring his wife and a barley flour offering to the priest.
The priest has the woman stand before the LORD, lets down her hair, and puts the offering in her hands.
The priest puts holy water in a clay jar and adds blood to it.
The woman says Amen, Amen, and the priest writes the curses on a scroll and burns it on the altar.

wrong_details.true: washes them off into the bitter water

lines.text: The husband will be free from guilt, but the woman shall bear her iniquity.
